title: ResponseComplete result_json payload
description: Shape of the result_json argument of the org.famulus.Conversation1 ResponseComplete signal (contract C2). Emitted by famulus-agentd once per turn when the supervised claude CLI reports the turn result.

session_id.description: Session identifier reported by the claude CLI for this conversation.

total_cost_usd.description: Total cost of the turn in US dollars as reported by the claude CLI.

is_error.description: True when the turn ended in a per-turn API error; process-level failures use the ConversationError signal instead.

num_turns.description: Number of agentic turns the CLI executed to produce this response.

duration_ms.description: Optional wall-clock duration of the turn in milliseconds.

duration_api_ms.description: Optional cumulative Anthropic API time for the turn in milliseconds.

usage.description: Optional free-form token-usage object as reported by the claude CLI.

subtype.description: Optional passthrough of the CLI result subtype (e.g. success, error_during_execution, error_max_turns). Open set: consumers MUST NOT reject unknown values.

terminal_reason.description: Optional passthrough of the CLI terminal_reason (e.g. completed; aborted_streaming after Cancel). Open set: consumers MUST NOT reject unknown values.
